items.text: YOLO 視覺辨識模型訓練與優化 / Vision Detection Model Training & Optimization
機器學習漁場預測模型訓練與優化 / Machine Learning Fishing Ground Prediction
LLM 應用開發 / LLM Application Development

description.text:
本職位負責跨產品線的 AI 系統開發與整合，核心工作涵蓋三大領域：影像辨識、機器學習預測系統、以及 LLM/Agent 應用開發。不侷限於單一技術領域，需具備將各類 AI 技術落地到實際產品與內部流程中的能力。
This role is responsible for cross-product-line AI system development and integration, spanning three core domains: computer vision, machine learning prediction systems, and LLM/agent application development. Rather than specializing in a single domain, this engineer will apply a broad range of AI techniques into both production systems and internal workflows.
【主要工作內容 / Key Responsibilities】
1. YOLO 視覺辨識模型訓練與優化 / Vision Detection Model Training & Optimization
・基於 Ultralytics YOLO 進行魚群 / 船隻目標偵測模型的訓練、評估、超參數調優
Train, evaluate, and tune hyperparameters for fish/vessel detection models using Ultralytics YOLO
・模型推論優化與匯出（ONNX / TensorRT），支援邊緣裝置部署
Optimize inference performance and export models (ONNX / TensorRT) for edge deployment
・管理 CVAT 標注後處理流程與訓練資料品質
Manage CVAT annotation post-processing workflows and training data quality
2. 機器學習漁場預測模型訓練與優化 / Machine Learning Fishing Ground Prediction
・整合衛星環境資料（SST、葉綠素、洋流）與船載感測器訊號（聲納、雷達），設計 ETL 與特徵工程管線
Integrate satellite environmental data (SST, chlorophyll, currents) with onboard sensor signals (sonar, radar); design ETL and feature engineering pipelines
・訓練與優化 CPUE / 漁場預測模型，結合時序、空間與環境變數
Train and optimize CPUE / fishing ground prediction models incorporating temporal, spatial, and environmental variables
・開發邊緣端推論模組，支援每日漁場建議與離線容錯機制
Develop edge inference modules for daily fishing ground recommendations and offline fallback mechanisms
3. LLM 應用開發 / LLM Application Development
・使用 Google ADK (Agent Development Kit)、Gemini SDK 開發 Agent 應用，串接內部系統與工作流程
Build agent applications using Google ADK (Agent Development Kit) and the Gemini SDK, integrating with internal systems and workflows
・使用 n8n 設計自動化流程，串接 LLM 與既有系統（如文件生成、資料處理、通知系統）
Design automation workflows using n8n to connect LLM capabilities with existing systems (e.g., document generation, data processing, notifications)
・評估並導入 RAG、Prompt Engineering 等技術於內部效率工具與客戶端功能
Evaluate and implement RAG, prompt engineering, and related techniques for internal efficiency tools and customer-facing features

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
【資格條件 / Requirements】
・大學（含）以上，資訊工程、電機工程、統計或相關科系
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, or a related field
・5 年以上 AI / 機器學習實作經驗，且在上述三大領域中至少具備兩項的實作經驗
5+ years of hands-on AI/ML experience, with practical experience in at least two of the three domains above
・熟悉 Python，具備良好的軟體工程實踐（版本控制、模組化程式碼、測試）
Proficient in Python with solid software engineering practices (version control, modular code, testing)
・熟悉至少一種主流深度學習框架（PyTorch / TensorFlow），並具備跨框架學習能力
Familiar with at least one major deep learning framework (PyTorch / TensorFlow), with demonstrated ability to pick up new frameworks/tools quickly
・熟悉 pandas、NumPy、xarray 等資料處理工具
Familiar with data processing tools such as pandas, NumPy, and xarray
・熟悉 Git 與 Conventional Commits 規範
Familiar with Git and the Conventional Commits standard
・具備將 AI 技術轉譯為產品功能的能力，能與非技術背景的產品/業務團隊溝通
Ability to translate AI capabilities into product features and communicate effectively with non-technical product/business stakeholders

Experience with Google ADK, Gemini SDK, or other agent development frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, etc.)
・具備 n8n 或其他工作流自動化工具經驗
Experience with n8n or other workflow automation tools
・具備 Copernicus Marine Service 或其他環境資料源使用經驗
Experience using Copernicus Marine Service or other environmental data sources
・具備時間序列特徵工程、海洋氣候相關領域知識
Knowledge of time-series feature engineering or ocean/climate-related domains
・具備 CVAT 或其他資料標注平台使用經驗
Experience with CVAT or other data annotation platforms
・具備 CUDA、nvidia-container-toolkit、或 MLOps（模型監控、CI/CD for ML）經驗
Experience with CUDA, nvidia-container-toolkit, or MLOps (model monitoring, CI/CD for ML)
